final: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, COUNT(*) as race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09' GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(CAST(race_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_race_count FROM race_counts GROUP BY country) SELECT rc.circuitId, rc.country, rc.race_count, CAST(rc.race_count AS FLOAT) / ca.avg_race_count as ratio FROM race_counts rc JOIN country_averages ca ON rc.country = ca.country ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
